news.title: Lori Vallow Daybell in appeal over killings of 2 of her children, romantic rival
news.summary: An Idaho appeals court is scheduled to hear Lori Vallow Daybell’s appeal of her convictions in Idaho for killing her two youngest children and conspiring to murder a romantic rival
